## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` pass
- [ ] Added or updated tests (regression test for bug fixes)
- [ ] UI changes keep keyboard access and contrast in light and dark themes
- [ ] No fabricated data; generated content keeps an accurate origin label
- [ ] Anything that sends user text off-device is opt-in and documented (docs/PRIVACY.md)
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
